says: The micro menu icons in two styles, painted (Blizzard-like, high resolution) and gold emblem (the panel's gold and bronze), on pure black to be keyed out (lunatype art key). Two ship, keyed into sources/micromenu: painted-quests 53 (source-questlog.png) and painted-help 102 (source-gamemenu.png) (piece micromenu).
